app.name: Tadhkirah
app.tagline: Remember, reflect, return, and improve — one day at a time.

landing.heroTitle: Gently hold yourself to account, and return to Allah every day
landing.heroBody: Tadhkirah is a calm, private space to review your day, keep your prayers and Quran portion, and remember authentic Sunnahs at the right moments — without points, comparisons or blame.
landing.heroNote: No password · No ads · Your data is yours alone
landing.featuresTitle: Everything you need for a day closer to Allah
landing.feature1Body: Daily questions you choose yourself, with room for gratitude, repentance and tomorrow's intention.
landing.feature2Body: Follow your prayers, adhkar and voluntary worship, with a clear line between obligatory and voluntary.
landing.feature3Body: Record your recitation, memorization and revision by surah and ayah.
landing.feature4Body: Reminders of Sunnahs and times of supplication, each with its source and grading, after scholarly review.
landing.dayBody: Tadhkirah calculates prayer times for your city on your device, and your day starts at Fajr — so Isha and Witr count for their day, even after midnight.
landing.principle1Body: Your reflections are yours alone. We never show them to anyone, sell them, or train any AI on them.
landing.principle2Body: No weak or fabricated hadith. Nothing is published without documented human review.
landing.principle3Body: No points, rankings or blame. We help you keep going and return — not compete.
landing.ctaBody: Two minutes to set up, then one day at a time, in shā' Allāh.
landing.footer: Made with care to help you do good.
landing.mockReflect: A moment to look back on your day
landing.skyHint: Tap a time to see its sky
landing.t1Body: Begin with the intention you wrote last night.
landing.t2Body: Log each prayer at its time with a single tap — no fuss.
landing.t3Body: A gentle nudge for evening adhkar and your Quran portion.
landing.t4Body: Authentic Sunnahs, with their sources, at the right moment.
landing.t5Body: Look back on your day, give thanks, and set tomorrow's intention.

auth.title: Sign in to Tadhkirah
auth.subtitle: No password needed. We'll email you a code and a sign-in link.
auth.resent: A new code is on its way.
auth.checkSpam: Can't find it? Check your spam folder, or tap the link in the email.
auth.privacyNote: We only ask for your email, and never share it.

verify.failed: This link is invalid or has expired.

today.intro: This is your daily page. Soon you'll find your prayers, adhkar and Quran portion here, and a moment to look back on your day.
today.dayBounds: Your day began at Fajr ({time}) in {place}.

onboarding.title: Let's set up your day
onboarding.subtitle: Just two steps so we can calculate prayer times and start your day at Fajr.
onboarding.locationHint: Times are calculated on your device. We store an approximate location (about 1 km) for reminders only.
onboarding.noResults: We couldn't find that city. Try your current location or enter coordinates.
onboarding.locationDenied: We couldn't access your location. Please choose your city from the list.
onboarding.methodHint: We picked the method most used in your country; you can change it. Compare it with your mosque's timetable.
onboarding.highLatHint: For places far from the equator, where twilight lasts long in summer.

comingSoon.title: Under construction
comingSoon.body: This section arrives in milestone {milestone}, in shā' Allāh.

settings.title: Settings
settings.hijriOffsetHint: If the moon sighting in your country differs from the Umm al-Qura calendar.
settings.khutbah: Friday khutbah time at your mosque (optional)
settings.adjustmentsHint: If your mosque's timetable differs by a minute or two.
settings.sessionsHint: Devices where you're signed in. Sign out any device you don't recognise.
settings.privacyBody: Exporting your data and deleting your account arrive in milestone 8, in shā' Allāh.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Couldn't connect. Check your internet and try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code is incorrect or has expired.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a little and try again.
errors.emailUnavailable: We couldn't send the email right now. Please try again shortly.

worship.title: My Worship
worship.excusedHint: For days of exemption such as menstruation or illness — they never count against you for prayer and fasting.
worship.saveError: Couldn't save. We'll try again with your next change.
worship.summary: {count, plural, =0 {No days yet this month} one {Logged on {logged} of {eligible} day this month} other {Logged on {logged} of {eligible} days this month}}
worship.summaryExcused: {count, plural, one {{n} excused day isn't counted} other {{n} excused days aren't counted}}
worship.gentle: No red marks and no streaks — every day is a fresh start.
worship.obligatoryNote: Obligatory acts have no goals — they're simply tracked.
worship.voluntaryNote: Voluntary acts are optional — choose what helps you stay consistent.

quran.nothingYet: You haven't logged any recitation this week yet.
quran.syncNote: Your pages are added to the Quran portion on the Today page automatically.
quran.revisionHint: Surahs you've memorized and haven't revised for a while — a gentle suggestion, not an obligation.
quran.noRevision: Nothing due for revision right now. May Allah bless you.

reflection.title: Self-accountability
reflection.intro: A quiet moment to look back on your day. Every question is optional, and no one but you sees what you write.
reflection.private: Private to you, and encrypted before it is saved

questions.prayers_on_time: Did I perform my obligatory prayers on time?
questions.quran_portion: Did I keep my daily Quran portion?
questions.adhkar: Did I say my morning and evening adhkar?
questions.remembrance: Did I remember Allah throughout the day?
questions.tongue: Did I avoid backbiting, lying and harming others?
questions.rights: Did I fulfil my responsibilities toward my family and others?
questions.good_deed: What good deed did Allah enable me to do today?

reflection.gratitude: What I'm grateful to Allah for today
reflection.shortcoming: Something I want to return from
reflection.shortcomingHint: The door of repentance is open — write what you want to leave for Allah.
reflection.repentance: I have sought Allah’s forgiveness for it
reflection.conflict: This reflection was changed on another device — we loaded the latest version.
reflection.closingBody: See you tomorrow, in shā' Allāh — one day at a time.
reflection.newQuestionPlaceholder: e.g. Did I keep ties with my relatives?
reflection.todayCardTitle: A moment to look back on your day
reflection.todayCardBody: Review your day calmly: what you were enabled to do, what you'll return from, and your intention for tomorrow.

reports.title: Reports
reports.excusedDays: {count, plural, =0 {No excused days} one {1 excused day} other {{n} excused days}}
reports.attentionBody: Not a judgement — just a gentle invitation for next week.
reports.attentionNone: Mā shāʾ Allāh — nothing needs attention this week.
reports.footer: Reports describe your habits — never your faith.
reports.noActivities: Enable activities in My Worship to see them here.
